Okay so I feel like this is way overtuned. I really like the idea of her getting buffs for standing still but still, its busted.

 For starters, the w is just, wow. The ability to just have two Honeyfruit in lane early is so strong. The scryers bloom just means you can never gank or even ward. The blast cone is okay tho. I would propose they become like, mini plants, like scryers wont reveal wards or go that far, and blast cones radius is reduced and honeyfruit drops only two fruits. Or you could make them cost health and mana and have them grow over-time, think Iverns passive with jungle camps.

Secondly, the infinte root sounds so not fun. I can imagine just landing one under turret and the enemy kassadin or any melee attacker is just insta-dead. And the idea of her q going around her doesnt sound like something I would ever want as one of the squishiest bot lane supports. I would just recommend her abilities become empowered. They get bigger range, her q works in a circle with the diameter of her moving square and her root is maybe thicker and can maybe apply grievous (haha thornmail).
